observations: HEICO reported record fiscal Q3 2026 net sales up 23%, operating income up 34%, net income up 33%, with 14% organic sales growth.
HEICO closed a $1.2B senior-notes offering, adding long-duration financing capacity but fixed obligations.
Current market data shows HEI around $308-$310 with roughly $43B market capitalization and trailing P/E near 50.7, making valuation demanding despite strong execution.
unknowns: Normalized post-acquisition leverage and customer concentration require future refresh.
